headline: Waymo robotaxis kept passing stopped school buses after a software fix
summary: Federal regulators are investigating after Waymo robotaxis continued illegally passing stopped school buses despite a software fix the company issued roughly a year ago to address the same problem.

claims.statement: Waymo robotaxis continued illegally passing stopped school buses even after a prior software fix.

sources.quote: Waymo robotaxis kept illegally passing school buses after software fix, feds say
Waymo Said It Fixed Its School Bus Problem. The US Government Says It Didn’t Work

claims.statement: US regulators are investigating whether Waymo's earlier software recall actually fixed the problem.

sources.quote: NHTSA investigates if Waymo robotaxis are still running school bus stop signs
The latest probe questions the effectiveness of Waymo's software recall from 2025.
Last year, Waymo recalled its software after several of its autonomous cars drove around stopped buses.
